stem: A required receiving weight was missed, but a worker remembers an approximate number. What should the record show?
choices: Enter the remembered number at the original time
Use the controlled missing-data/late-entry process and do not invent an original measurement
rationale: Use the controlled missing-data/late-entry process and do not invent an original measurement. This preserves the Course 006 safety, postharvest, traceability, contamination-control, authority or record-quality principle being assessed.
